title: Pinoy artists ena mori, SHNTI bag nominations at Taiwan's Golden Indie Music Awards
summary: Filipino artists ena mori and SHNTI are among the nominees at Taiwan's 17th Golden Indie Music Awards (GIMA), an award-giving body dedicated to original music.
